title: oenothera fruticosa var. linearis
intro: Oenothera fruticosa var. linearis, commonly known as a variety of the Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Onagraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, skin conditions, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera fruticosa var. linearis include unsaturated fatty acids, particularly gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which has been shown to have a positive impact on human health.
